entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 4570796456599587200: position at J2016.0. Distance: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: distance 113.25 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.025), at which the luminosity and radius hold (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433): 113.25 +/- 2.831 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 8.2943 +/- 0.0921 mas (same row, RUWE 2.29), 90.1 standard errors, is not used. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): 18.782, 16.184 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 35.546 solar radii from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: radius 35.546 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 352.896 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.065) and temperature (https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stx1433). No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 4199 +/- 125 K from McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 85693: effective temperature 4199 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.061).
